## Why

Citation commands should follow the active Notes-pane caret, including when writing a citation inside an explanatory footnote or endnote. The previous Word-like Zotero increment left this workflow disconnected.

## Work in progress

- Reconciled 207 fork branches, 169 PR heads and four upstream branches before feature work. The baseline includes the latest review/Zotero work, the completed offline thesaurus head `315beeb3`, and main `4fbc8741`; all 380 captured refs are accounted for through ancestry or freshly checked historical equivalence.
- Saved the combined baseline at `fcb8a4b0` and existing-note native engine support at `a4915a55`.
- Engine insertion preserves the existing note and explanatory text, processor reading order, physical note index, and native formatting. Incompatible note conversion and bibliography insertion into notes are rejected.
- Notes-pane/controller routing, offline insertion, exact selection undo/redo and guarded native keyboard commands are being completed and locally tested.

## Local validation so far

The engine increment passed 139 focused cases. Pinned Flutter 3.47.8 / Dart 3.13.7 and the recorded dependency lock are restored. Final combined-source qualification will replace this provisional section when complete.

GitHub Actions are not queried, awaited, dispatched or rerun. Incremental checkpoints are saved using non-forced, expected-head updates and `[skip ci]` messages.
